name: photoprism
title: PhotoPrism
description: PhotoPrism indexes your photo library with face recognition, maps and automatic tagging, all on your own hardware. Point it at the folder with your originals; the admin login is the one you set here.

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: For the admin account; at least 8 characters

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_ORIGINALS_PATH
variables.label: Originals folder
variables.description: Host directory with your photos and videos

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL
variables.label: Public URL
variables.description: The URL you open PhotoPrism at (used in links and sharing)

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: PHOTOPRISM_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database root password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)

policy_needs.reason: PhotoPrism's own compose file turns AppArmor off: its TensorFlow and video tools need it
PhotoPrism's own compose file turns seccomp off: its TensorFlow and video tools make system calls Docker's default profile blocks
the database of PhotoPrism's own compose file runs with AppArmor off
the database of PhotoPrism's own compose file runs with seccomp off
